_one_line: ONE CANONICAL STORE. ONE PROJECTION. RENDERERS RENDER. RETIRED STORES ARE VERSIONED, NEVER DELETED.
_why: The registry had lived at four nodes under four regimes — v10.0/300 at alexanarch, v9.55/288 at machinemediation, v9.4/202 at godkinggoogle, v7.2/131 at leesharks — with two of them holding stores nothing read. A human saw 300 records while a crawler reading a gallery repository found 131, at a version two months old, with nothing saying it was superseded.

canonical_store.rule: THE ONLY THING WRITTEN TO. Entry is written here and nowhere else.

public_projection.rule: DERIVED from the canonical store for publication. Regenerated after every change; it went stale within an hour once.

renderer.rule: Fetches the projection at render time and STORES NOTHING. A gallery is a window, not a store.
renderer.status: store retired 2026-08-13; last contents kept as a dated snapshot beside the pointer

hosted_mirror.rule: Holds a COPY of the projection, so it must be re-synced and must declare its own freshness.
hosted_mirror.status: UNRESOLVED — MANUS ruling outstanding on whether this becomes a renderer or stays a hosted mirror with a sync step and a staleness banner. Its data/registry.json still declares the OLD source of truth (alexanarch:data/...) rather than the rebuild.

intake: One contract: alexanarch:rebuild/capture-registry/INTAKE-CONTRACT.md. Nodes REFERENCE it; none restates it.
freeze: datasets/dataflow-atlas/fleet-freeze-20260813.json — all four nodes with version, date, counts and sha256 before normalization.
gates: scripts/capture_intake.py — refuses a capture that cannot be read
scripts/check_gallery_js.js — executes the page scripts; node --check is a syntax check and passed while the page was broken
scripts/check_render_determinism.py — two builds must be byte-identical
scripts/check_fleet_sync.py — a node declaring a count or version divergent from canonical fails the build
versioning_rule: MANUS: "retired stores keep their bytes as dated snapshots. we are versioning, not tombstoning."
